scope: the 13 CVEs of the 2026-09-29 OpenSSL advisory whose NVD configuration covers 3.5.0 <= v < 3.5.9 (CVE-2026-84783 is 4.0.0-4.0.3 only)
method: frozen 3.5.8 line read verbatim at the anchor; the fix commit is the 3.5-branch commit whose message cites the CVE; its diff for the anchored file is split per hunk. removed_line means the frozen line is one the hunk deletes; adjacent_insertion means the fix is additive and the frozen line is the statement the inserted guard governs; structural_shift means the fix targets code introduced on the branch after 3.5.8 and the frozen line is the equivalent defect site.
